test_objective: Check that you can append entity attributes

test_cases.name: 010_04_01 Append entity attributes
test_cases.doc: Check that you can append entity attributes
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response containing:
        Check Response Body Content and
    Query Parameter: additional_ignored_path set to '${EMPTY}' and
        Updated Entity set to ${entity} and
        Response Status Code set to 207
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/'
        method set to ''
        Request Retrieve Entity by Id and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/ld+json'
}
